investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Eval Failing: POST /api/agents Returns 409 Agent Quota Exceeded (limit is 100)
investigation.summary: The AURA observability eval for remote-agent-create (and all sibling checks remote-agent-state and remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-15T09:55:11Z because POST /api/agents returned HTTP 409 with the error "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". The eval probe never received a successful agent creation response, so zero required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) were collected and all contract assertions went unverified. This is an eval-layer failure reflecting a real API-level quota enforcement condition; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the packet to confirm a broader production outage.
investigation.rootCause: The production Swarm API is enforcing a hard agent quota of 100 for the org used by the observability probe. When the eval runner called POST /api/agents (via createAgent in infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 808), the API rejected the request with HTTP 409 "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100" before any agent was provisioned. Because agent creation is the shared first step for all three remote-agent checks, all three checks failed with the identical error message. The eval never progressed past the creation call, leaving all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) absent and both contract assertions (vmIdPresent=true, remoteState oneOf [running, idle, ready]) unverifiable.

investigation.rootCause: The eval runner (`infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs`, line 907) issued an SSE request to `/api/generate/image/stream` against the `production-api` runtime environment. The check is marked `required: false` with `statusImpact: informational` (evidence id: `source.check-config.image-generation-stream`), so this is an eval observability failure, not a declared product outage.

investigations.rootCause: The production Swarm API is enforcing a hard agent quota of 100 for the org used by the observability probe. When the eval runner called POST /api/agents (via createAgent in infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 808), the API rejected the request with HTTP 409 "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100" before any agent was provisioned. Because agent creation is the shared first step for all three remote-agent checks, all three checks failed with the identical error message. The eval never progressed past the creation call, leaving all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) absent and both contract assertions (vmIdPresent=true, remoteState oneOf [running, idle, ready]) unverifiable.
